### Observed differences

- A02 is no longer observed in the later window: it took part in about 53 of 200 traces (roughly 26%) in the earlier window and in 0 of 200 afterwards, with no outgoing transitions observed from it later. [OCC001, DIR002]
- In the earlier window, A01 sat late in the trace (mean position about 0.82 of the trace length), came after A11 and A12, and always passed directly to A05. In the later window, A01 always occurs at the first position, A11 and A12 now come after it (A01 precedes each of them in all of their roughly 21–22% co-occurrences, whereas earlier each of them preceded A01 in about 27% of traces), and every observed A01 transition now goes to A06. [POS001, DIR001, REL002, REL003]
- A05 is now reached from A11 and A12 instead of from A01: A11's outgoing transitions shifted from A01 (about 57%) and A12 (about 43%) to A05 (about 70%) and A12 (about 30%); A12's shifted from A11 (about 57%) and A01 (about 43%) to A11 (about 70%) and A05 (about 30%). A05 now follows A11 after one step in about 70 of 100 cases (previously two to three steps), while the A01–A05 distance grew from always one step to four steps. [DIR004, DIR005, LAG004, LAG005, LAG001]
- A06, A11 and A12 all occur later in the trace than before (mean positions about 0.22 to 0.35, 0.55 to 0.75, and 0.52 to 0.67 respectively), and the A06–A05 distance moved from always four steps to mostly three steps. [POS003, POS005, POS006, LAG002]
- A07's outgoing transitions moved away from A02 (about 34% earlier; A02 no longer occurs) toward A03 (about 21% to 48%) and A13 (about 8% to 29%), and A07 now appears much earlier in the trace (mean position about 0.24 to 0.06). [DIR003, REL006, POS004]

### Inference

Support level: Supported hypothesis

The evidence supports the possibility of a structural reconfiguration involving A01, A02, A05, A06, A11 and A12: A02 is no longer executed in the observed traces, and the sequence around A01 was reordered — A01 moved from a late position, preceded by A11 and A12 and followed immediately by A05, to the start of the trace, now followed by A06, while A05 is now reached directly from A11 and A12 rather than from A01. The hypothesis rests on direct relational and positional evidence (a successor change at A01 from 100% A05 to 100% A06, clean order flips with A11 and A12, and A01's shift to the first position), and the indicators agree with one another; the volume of qualifying items (25 control-flow items against roughly 0.22 expected without change) is far beyond what random re-splits of these windows produce, so chance sampling cannot explain the pattern as a whole. Limitations: zero participation only means A02 was not observed in the later window, so removal versus extreme rarity cannot be distinguished, and with two 200-trace windows the evidence cannot rule out that the windows capture different mixes of process variants rather than one modified behaviour. [OCC001, DIR001, DIR002, POS001, REL002, REL003, DIR004, DIR005, LAG001, LAG004]

Other differences: A07's outgoing transitions redistributed toward A03 and A13 and A07 now occurs earlier in the trace; these accompany the reconfiguration but are not part of the main hypothesis. [DIR003, POS004]
